setup.title: Let's connect your invoice mailbox
setup.lead: Docsweep reads this mailbox, saves invoices as named PDF files and tidies up afterwards. Nothing changes until you have seen a preview.
setup.only_imap: Works with IMAP and a password or app password. Mailboxes that require OAuth2, such as Microsoft 365, are not supported.
setup.broken_lead: Docsweep could not use this file. Please correct it and start again.
mailbox.field.password_stored: Stored in the system keychain. Type here to replace it.
mailbox.field.password_hint: Goes straight into the system keychain, never into a file.
mailbox.title: Mailboxes
mailbox.remove_text: Docsweep stops reading this mailbox. Its mails and your saved invoices stay where they are.
mailbox.last_one: Docsweep needs at least one mailbox.
cleanup.title: After an invoice is saved
cleanup.lead: The default for all companies. Each company can override it.
cleanup.pdf_move_link_delete: Move PDF mails, delete link mails
cleanup.pdf_move_link_delete_hint: Keeps mails with invoices as a record. Link mails are deleted once their invoice is stored.
cleanup.all_move_hint: Nothing gets deleted. Everything ends up in one folder.
cleanup.all_delete_hint: Your inbox stays empty. The saved PDF is your record.
cleanup.folder_hint: Created if it does not exist. Use / between levels.
cleanup.trash: Deleting moves mails to the trash
cleanup.trash_hint: Recommended. Without a trash folder on the server, mails stay where they are.
cleanup.permanent_warning: Deleted mails are gone for good and cannot be restored.
cleanup.safety: A mail is only touched after its invoice is saved and indexed.
scan.title: Scan
scan.idle_title: See what is waiting in your inbox
scan.idle_lead: A preview changes nothing: no files, no flags, no moved mails. You decide afterwards.
scan.no_companies: Add a company first, so Docsweep knows which mails are invoices.
scan.empty_lead: No mail in your mailboxes matches a company right now.
scan.preview_note: Preview. Nothing has been changed yet.
scan.nothing_to_run: Nothing to save or tidy up.
scan.confirm_text: This is the real run. A mail is only touched after its invoice is saved and indexed.
scan.confirm_reviews_one: Save {count} file for review; its mail stays
scan.confirm_reviews_other: Save {count} files for review; their mails stay
scan.confirm_notes_one: Note {count} mail for a later portal download
scan.confirm_notes_other: Note {count} mails for a later portal download
row.review_conflict: Number known with a different file
row.portal: Noted for a later portal download
row.no_document: No PDF, and no portal configured
invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.lead: Everything Docsweep has saved or noted.
invoices.empty_lead: They appear here after your first scan.
review.title: Complete this invoice
review.lead: Open the file, then enter what Docsweep could not read. The file is renamed, and the next scan tidies up its mail.
companies.title: Companies
companies.lead: Who sends you invoices, and how they are filed.
companies.empty_lead: Add the companies that send you invoices. Docsweep recognises their mails by the sender's domain.
companies.select: Select a company to edit it.
companies.field.name: Name
companies.section.mails_lead: All conditions you fill in must match. Subdomains count as well.
companies.field.subject: Subject pattern
companies.field.dir_no_default: Required, because no default folder is set under Settings.
companies.discard_text: What you entered here will be lost.
companies.disposal.delete_trash: Moves the mail to the trash.
companies.disposal.delete_permanent: Deletes the mail permanently, as set under Settings.
companies.portal.toggle: Invoices also arrive as links to a portal
companies.portal.note: Portal downloads come in a later version. Until then, link mails are noted and stay in your inbox.
companies.delete_text: Docsweep stops recognising its mails. Saved invoices and index entries stay.
history.title: History
history.lead: Every real run. Previews change nothing and are not listed.
history.empty_lead: After your first real run, you can see here what happened to each mail.
history.nothing: Nothing to do in this run.
settings.title: Settings
settings.folder.title: Where invoices go
settings.folder.label: Default folder
settings.folder.hint: Companies use this folder unless you choose another one for them.
settings.folder.moved_note: Changing it applies to new invoices. Files already saved stay where they are.
